label: GO after a rewarded a2 trial; strongest after a2 -> S1 rare-rewarded
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO, prev_reward=1 in 100% of activations); it never fires at D1 or D2. It is mostly after the previous choice was a2 (83% of mass), and the agent is then about to pick a2 (model_act=2 in 91% of mass, strongly negative choice logit). Magnitude: the large activations (74% of mass) come after an a2 -> S1 rare transition that was rewarded (prev_common=0). Precision there is 0.54 and rises to about 0.8 with ep_trial<50, but this covers only 35% of active steps. A weak, broad component fires on GO after rewarded a2 trials early in the episode (ep_trial<30). The firing rate falls steadily with ep_trial and is zero after trial ~80. It is also more common in episodes that started with S2 good. Does not fire after unrewarded trials or after a1 choices (with few exceptions). All variables used are observed at GO, so uses_future=false. The episode-time dependence makes the boundary fuzzy, so this is only partially explained.
